evidence.why: Exact edge, countdown and emission branch order.
Physical-only callback execution and all-slot initialization.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's exact-period wording while preserving the source's countdown ordering and aggregate exception.
facts.value: Resets controller inputs and repeat-duration state, configures initial countdown 20, duration thresholds 40 and 100, and repeat countdown reloads 8, 4, and 2. Every physical and aggregate slot starts with timer 20; the installed callback subsequently updates only physical slots. A trigger or release reloads 20, clears duration, and emits the trigger mask. Otherwise a nonzero entry timer decrements and suppresses output even when the decrement reaches zero; a later invocation entering with zero emits held buttons. Stable-tier emission spacing is therefore reload plus one callback invocations, absent edges or timer overrides.

evidence.why: Read-only accessor and exact alias guards.
Concrete mappings and per-port trigger aggregation.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes physical rising edges from independently synthesized semantic aliases and aggregate OR behavior.
facts.value: Returns the selected controller-map slot's processed trigger snapshot without consuming it. Physical triggers originate in HSD rising-edge detection; semantic trigger bits are added from matching source edges, with an additional current-chord condition for chord aliases. The aggregate slot ORs physical-port trigger masks. Semantic and aggregate trigger bits are not necessarily rising edges of their corresponding held masks: another source button or port can trigger the same command while that command is already held.
